meta.description: T-bar cabinet handle, 128mm centres (Interior Cabinetry). Unified asset: plan, elevation, 3D mesh and cabinet placement data. Units mm.
meta.namingConvention: All custom keys prefixed Na__. Three-stage form Na__Section__SubSection__FieldName. Geometry primitives in Paths arrays use PathType (Line | Arc | Circle | Polygon).

fieldPrefixes.Na__Asset__: Top-level asset metadata and content blocks
fieldPrefixes.Na__CabinetPlacement__: Cabinet mounting data read by the Interior Cabinetry builders

Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Description: T-bar cabinet handle: 12mm round bar, 188 long on two 10mm posts at 128mm centres, standing 41 proud of the door.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Notes: The most common UK kitchen handle size. Origin on the door face between the fixings.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__CabinetPlacement__Note: Origin on the door face at the centre of the fixings; X runs along the bar, Z stands out of the door.

Na__Asset__Plan2D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0 = centre of the fixings on the door face. Seen from above, Y out of the door.
Na__Asset__Plan2D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: XY plane | X=along the bar, Y=out of the door | Units=mm

Na__Asset__Elevation2D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0 = centre of the fixings. Seen from the front of the door.
Na__Asset__Elevation2D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: XY plane | X=along the bar, Y=across | Units=mm

Na__Asset__Mesh3D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0,0 = centre of the fixings on the door face; Z out of the door.
